sv.title: Nordic Capital: Då kan Cary Group vara börsaktuella igen
sv.summary: Nordic Capital gör sin tredje exit i bilglasbolaget Cary Group – en unik situation för riskkapitalbolaget som vanligtvis har en mycket kortare investeringshorisont än vad man haft här. ”Det handlar om att vi fortsatt ser väldigt mycket möjligheter”, säger ansvarige partnern Joakim Andreasson.

en.title: Nordic Capital: Then Cary Group could be listed again
en.summary: Nordic Capital is making its third exit from car glass company Cary Group – a unique situation for the private equity firm, which usually has a much shorter investment horizon than it has here. “It is about us still seeing a great deal of opportunities”, says responsible partner Joakim Andreasson.
